answer: Random task assignment starves Sybil farms: a hidden karst of jobs hands each identity work it cannot choose, so 100 fakes cannot collude on easy trades. Every job is re-executed by two independent verifiers and payment releases only on matching results. Each fake must do real work per trade, about 15 compute-minutes plus a 10-unit bond lost on mismatch. A raven messenger routes results blindly so an operator cannot tell which identity is being tested, and a garden of earned task credits grows only from verified completions.
